messages:
sam_sales: Bankridge wants SSO (Okta), SCIM group sync, RBAC mapping, and domain proof for bankridge.com + bankridge.eu. Also need hosted vs dedicated cost estimate for ~2.8M tokens/mo and ~4k users.
eli_se: I'll run the POC. Quick checklist: IdP metadata (xml), SCIM token, DNS write access for TXT proof, and a role->group mapping CSV.
marta_sec: FYI we can provide SOC2 Type II attestation and customer-managed KMS options. For the POC we'll enable 90-day export to S3 and masked generation logs. For production we support 13mo retention and audit exports.
eli_se: SAML note: we expect assertions with email, name, groups. If groups omitted we'll rely on SCIM->role mapping. Example mapping: saml_group:credit-ops -> role:fin_ops
sam_sales: When can we kickoff? Client prefers next Tue morning.
devops_bot: deploy/preview created for customer: pr-3789. Invite sent to elli@bankridge.com
eli_se: I'll book the test slot and share a short runbook before the call (SAML metadata, SCIM base URL & token, sample groups list). Also: SCIM rate-limit on hosted is 200 reqs/min — recommend delta sync for large imports.
marta_sec: Also confirm domain verification method: TXT preferred; delegated CNAME possible if they want us to handle verification. TXT usually verifies in 5-10m after propagation but allow up to 24h.
sam_sales: Thanks all — I'll follow up with calendar + a quick pricing comparison (hosted vs dedicated) once POC scope is confirmed. :thumbsup:
